No standard metadata/source reads gain content permission.

root_hooks.hosted: Allow only selected_azure_ml_command_jobs array of exact {resource_id}; source.selected_targets exported pure validator; no caller endpoints, source URLs, keys or credential fields.
root_hooks.metadata: Existing Secrets group/high and 1–3 brief English evidence sentences; explicit native declaration-only scope, not complete ML source coverage.
root_hooks.registry: Separate source/fixture-bound atomic admission only after acceptance; typed evaluator plus reachable _evaluate; new native CASES only. No numbered compliance edges.
